preregistered.registered: 2026-10-22, before any Stage 11 diagnostic was run (Owen's go on the plan, with the co-primary no-own-sale check)
preregistered.scope: Verdict from CV 2021-2024 pooled (out-of-fold frozen primary; assessor roll Y). 2025 is reported only and never changes the verdict.

definitions.failing_tier: a neighborhood value tier (low, mid, high) where the method's observed CV within-tier PRB < -0.05 (ratios level-normalized by the method's median ratio within each year and tier)
definitions.PRB_null: mean PRB over 2,000 simulated perfectly calibrated valuations: synthetic price P* = V * exp(u + e), V = the method's actual level-normalized values, e ~ N(0, sigma_p^2) sale noise from repeat sales (Case-Shiller intercept, per tier, redrawn from its bootstrap), u ~ N(0, sigma_u^2) with sigma_u^2 = robust variance of log(P / V) minus sigma_p^2
definitions.E: observed PRB minus PRB_null; 95% interval combines the neighborhood-clustered bootstrap of the observed PRB and the simulation spread
definitions.Q_frozen: proxy PRB for the frozen model: PRB formula with log2(proxy) as the value term, proxy = the home's most recent clean prior sale at least 24 months before the target sale, index-adjusted with the fold's training-only time effect; corrected for the own-prior-sale feature leak (beta from refit fold models, +/-0.05 finite difference) and disattenuated for proxy noise (sigma_q^2 = sigma_p^2 + drift * gap); 95% neighborhood-clustered bootstrap interval
definitions.Q_noown: proxy PRB for the frozen spec refit on each CV fold WITHOUT the own-prior-sale feature group (no leak), disattenuated the same way
definitions.Q_assessor: assessor proxy PRB, disattenuated; no leak correction is possible (bias direction stated: toward progressive)

rule.mostly measurement artifact: in EVERY failing tier: (3) PRB_null <= 0.5 * observed PRB (both negative) and E's interval includes 0 or lies within [-0.05, +0.05]; AND (2) Q_frozen's interval includes 0 or lies within [-0.05, +0.05]; AND Q_noown agrees with Q_frozen in direction (its interval also includes 0 or lies within [-0.05, +0.05])
rule.real compression: in AT LEAST ONE failing tier: Q_frozen's interval lies entirely below 0 AND E's interval lies entirely below 0 AND Q_noown's interval lies entirely below 0 (agreement in direction)
rule.otherwise: mixed, not resolved: name the diagnostic(s) that disagree, including any disagreement between Q_frozen and Q_noown; no fix is tested
rule.assessor: the same rule applied to the assessor with Q_assessor in place of Q_frozen and no Q_noown condition; reported alongside, does not affect the model verdict
rule.context_only: Diagnostics 1 (calibration slopes) and 4 (tier-specific time adjustment) do not change the verdict. If tier-specific time adjustment alone moves a failing tier's PRB into [-0.05, +0.05], the verdict states that the pattern depends on the time adjustment. Raw (uncorrected) proxy PRB and the two-prior-sales robustness check are reported next to Q; if they point the other way, the summary says so.
rule.fixes: tested only if the verdict is 'real compression': (a) post-hoc linear calibration by tier fit on earlier folds' out-of-fold predictions; (b) tier-aware features (neighborhood value tier, prior-3-year neighborhood median price). Keep candidates within +0.2 pts of the frozen model's mean CV level-neutral MdAPE; pick the smallest mean |Q|. The winner is a separate v2 model; the frozen model, its spec and the prospective 2026 file never change.

amendments.timing: made after seeing the 2021-fold sample (reports/stage11_prb/sample/) and before any full CV 2021-2024 result was computed
amendments.why: A calibrated valuation of finite accuracy (right on average given its value, with error) has negative Q against true value: it is pulled toward the mean relative to truth, so its ratio falls as true value rises. In the 2021 sample the Q expected from such a valuation was about -0.03 to -0.37 by tier and method. Judging Q against 0 would call any imperfect calibrated valuation 'compressed' and make 'artifact' a stricter standard than calibration. Diagnostic 3 already compares PRB with a calibrated valuation; Q now uses the same reference.

changes.Q_null: from the same simulation as PRB_null: synthetic proxy q* = log(V) + u + e_q (u the simulated valuation error, e_q ~ N(0, sigma_p^2 + drift * gap) per home), Q computed and disattenuated exactly as for the observed Q (no leak term). Mean over draws.
changes.D: D = Q - Q_null for Q_frozen (leak-corrected), D_noown = Q_noown - Q_noown_null, D_assessor likewise; 95% interval = clustered bootstrap of Q minus simulation draws of Q_null.
changes.mostly measurement artifact: in EVERY failing tier: PRB_null <= 0.5 * observed PRB (both negative) and E's interval includes 0 or lies within [-0.05, +0.05]; AND D's interval includes 0 or lies within [-0.05, +0.05]; AND D_noown agrees (its interval also includes 0 or lies within [-0.05, +0.05])
changes.real compression: in AT LEAST ONE failing tier: D's interval lies entirely below 0 AND E's interval lies entirely below 0 AND D_noown's interval lies entirely below 0
changes.otherwise: mixed, not resolved, naming the disagreement (unchanged)
changes.assessor: same rule with D_assessor, no D_noown condition (unchanged form)
changes.noise_shape_sensitivity: the t(4) noise variant is replaced by draws from the standardized trimmed repeat-sale residuals of the tier (sensitivity only; does not affect the verdict)
changes.not_identified: a bootstrap draw with proxy reliability <= 0.2 cannot be disattenuated; if more than 2.5% of draws are like that, the corrected interval is not identified (NaN) and the tier can be neither artifact nor compression

amendments.added_regardless_of_verdict: tradeoff curve on CV 2021-2024: within each tier, log values scaled around the tier mean by k from 1 to about 1/slope in 8 steps, with the slope (and so the k grid) fit on earlier folds only (out-of-fold predictions of the frozen spec from 2018 up to Y-1); level-neutral MdAPE, D and PRB reported per k; the assessor placed on the same axes

reasons: low: noise explains >= half: True; E within/includes 0: True; E below 0: False; D within/includes 0: False; D below 0: False; D_noown within/includes 0: False; D_noown below 0: False
mid: noise explains >= half: True; E within/includes 0: False; E below 0: True; D within/includes 0: True; D below 0: False; D_noown within/includes 0: True; D_noown below 0: False

high: noise explains >= half: True; E within/includes 0: True; E below 0: False; D within/includes 0: False; D below 0: False; D_noown within/includes 0: True; D_noown below 0: False; D and D_noown disagree in direction
low: noise explains >= half: True; E within/includes 0: False; E below 0: False; D within/includes 0: False; D below 0: False
